title: PrepNotes
description: A web application to help students extract notes and answer questions. Solution was selected as a Top 4 solution in India for the Smart India Hackathon.

title: English Wisper
description: Created a game "English Whisper" (similar to "Chinese Whisper") using Angular and Node.js, connecting multiple users in real time via sockets. Won first place at FOSSCON 2019 hackathon.
